text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!!)

—Cheers swirled all around. Expectations, excitement, screams
for the Umamusume they were rooting for...
And of course, many voices calling out for Still in Love...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Still~~! Still in Love—!!
Don't give up, keep holding on—!!
Go for it~~! Keep pushing hard—!!
choice_data_list: (There are so many people who love you—)
(There are so many people who love you—)

text_block_list.text:
Even so, she's finished here.
We won't get to see this running anymore――

At first, I was simply mesmerized by the intense running her instincts showed me.
However—

"As we spent our days together, I found myself wanting to support her—
her humble, hardworking self... fighting against her own fate."
choice_data_list: (I don't want it to end like this... but—)

text_block_list.text: She is... at her most beautiful when she's smiling.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!!
choice_data_list: Still... you can do it—!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew!
Fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My guess was off, but...
it seems the "monster" really has vanished.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Then we just change our target!
Now, where's the next treasure?!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Did I make my move a little too early?
Still, it went almost just as planned.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Put everything together, and report to Air Groove-san.
...Next time, I'll run a perfect race.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...My heart feels like a calm sea.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(My heart isn't in racing anymore.
Those who aren't worthy have to leave...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
And so,
we shall begin our brand-new days—!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer, Trainer...!
What shall we do? Where should we start?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(The future ahead of me is a blank slate...
I can do anything... Whatever shall I do?—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Are you crying...?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm just so happy...
I'm sorry, I'm just so happy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Can you hear it? Still...

text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Man, Still in Love!
She was so cool again today!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Triple Tiara Umamusume of our generation!
Let's keep cheering her on!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Your running is... the best.
Your running is... simply the best.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: I'm so glad... really... thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...I love it.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I love you for crying for my sake.
Your shy smiles, all of it...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (I love you—so very much.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I understand. What will make you the happiest—
is for me to keep running.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (But... if I do that, then once again—)
"—A monster."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (No... But... I want them to be happy. ...Still, no, no, no!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Whether it's unladylike, or not normal...!
Besides... there's no going back either way.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (—Still...)

After finishing all preparations,
on the way back to the academy—
choice_data_list: Let me go make a quick call.
I'll go make a quick call, okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Where to, exactly?
choice_data_list: Tracen Academy. ...Come on, we have paperwork to do.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um.
Could you wait... just a little bit?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“...Tomorrow.
Please wait until tomorrow... And then—”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Would you... go out with me again...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Good morning.
choice_data_list: Huh, you're early. ...Wait, don't tell me you're—
Huh, you're early. ...Wait, don't tell me you're—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: N-No...! Today, I really did just get here right now...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It's now, two hours ago.
...Let's go.

And so, just like on Valentine's Day,
Still in Love invited me out, and we
ended up going on an outing—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Wah... there are so many people...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If we get separated once here...
we might never find each other again.
choice_data_list: Don't worry. I'm really good at finding you!
Don't worry. I'm really good at finding you!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Well then... I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: âAh, how cute...
choice_data_list: Hmm, which one?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...
It's the bat keychain next to the cash register."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's stylized so nicely.
Its eyes are so glossy... absolutely adorable.
choice_data_list: If you like it, should we buy it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No, really...!
I'm fine. I was just really happy, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...To be honest, aren't bats generally kind of disliked?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, after being made to look this cute...
Surely, they will love me now."
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head to the next place?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...The day really flew by, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
did you have a good time?
choice_data_list: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me,
I'm going to head to the restroom.
choice_data_list: (...Still?)

text_block_list.text:
Was it just my imagination? For a fleeting moment,
her face lit by the sunset looked so sorrowful.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it.
I should have known... that it's completely different.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer-san seemed to be having fun today, too.
I believe that was genuine... but—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (――This is completely... different... from the smile she shows us after a race...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(—The look I want directed at me...
The emotion I want... isn't kindness...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(That intensity she shows after a race...
burning with an insatiable hunger for my running.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I was dreaming.
Of a peaceful future spent with you...—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Over here...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it beautiful?
I've always wanted to show you..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
""Ah... So blissful.
Tell me, how about you...?""

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (――...No, that's wrong.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (For that person to be at their happiest—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Shall we head home soon—
choice_data_list: Oh, before that... take this.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Is this...
a bat...?

What I handed her was the bat keychain she had been looking at earlier.
I had gone and bought it while she stepped away.
choice_data_list: Because... I thought you were so lovely.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You are... far too kind—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...What about you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of person I am...
you will still accept me, won't you?
choice_data_list: ...Of course. Even you when you're not racing, too.
...Of course. Even you when you're not racing, too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Keep running, me too?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please do not contact the academy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even from now on...
I'll keep entering races.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Would you mind?
choice_data_list: N-No... but...

text_block_list.text:
I found myself at a loss for words.
...Still in Love smiled wistfully.
choice_data_list: ...What's wrong?
...What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"After running the Kinko Sho...
it made me want to dream more, and more."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—Show me the next race.
Show me... the next dream.”

Still in Love's eyes are deadly serious.
It seems this decision came straight from her heart.

There were so many things I should ask. But...
the very first thing that surfaced in my heart was—

A quest for her next victory.
It was her newfound anticipation for the races.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...Ngh, got it, let's keep running...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You're... much more wonderful that way.
After our discussion, her next race was set to be the "Takarazuka Kinen," where fan expectations ran high for the Triple Tiara Umamusume. However...
choice_data_list: (…What's gotten into me—)
(…What's gotten into me—)

text_block_list.text:
"A smile spread across my face. Rather than worrying about her change of heart,
I felt something terrifying...
in my own inability to contain my joy—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Wake up.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha♡

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
I knew you would wake me up...
Because you are—

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
Something monstrously greedy...
and deeply, utterly—starving...

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you've steeled your resolve, right?
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
That means I can do
w-h-a-t-e-v-e-r  I  w-a-n-t, right...!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
After all... I need you if I'm to win.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Lend me your strength, more than ever before.
...Feel free to go wild.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If it brings joy to them――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'll even turn into a monster if that's what it takes.
